name: google-play-console
description: Manage Google Play Console with named, typed API actions and guided workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Play apps, releases, and analytics.
interface.longDescription: Access every published Android Publisher v3 and Play Developer Reporting v1beta1/v1alpha1 API operation as a typed MCP action. High-impact writes require per-tool approval configuration in Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Google Play Console to manage my apps and analytics.
